response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with a strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling) and some genuinely relevant exposure to developer tooling — notably C/C++ work on National Instruments' LabWindows/CVI IDE and authoring test frameworks/libraries for D. However, the role's core requirements are deep Java/Kotlin/JVM expertise plus hands-on Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate, build tools, and application server integration, and the resume shows almost none of this: Java appears only as a passing mention in a 2016–2018 role, Kotlin and Spring are absent entirely, and the last decade of work is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js and D. The gap between the required enterprise JVM ecosystem depth and the demonstrated experience is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own JVM tooling subsystems end-to-end.
strengths: Prior IDE product experience (LabWindows/CVI at National Instruments)
Builds developer tooling and test frameworks; strong TDD/craftsmanship culture
Broad systems experience incl. low-latency, high-throughput microservices
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate experience
Java exposure is minimal and roughly a decade old
Recent work is JS/TypeScript-centric, not JVM or language tooling
